submitted.rationale: XRD shows the same FTO substrate peaks everywhere (Q≈1.87, 2.38, 2.65, 3.54, 4.42). There is a V-oxide-type phase at Q≈1.32/1.43/1.53/2.04, and it is strongest at high V. Ni-rich films show a NiO-like peak (Q≈3.01). Photocurrent rose steadily with V fraction: 4.8e-7 A (Ni 0.34), 7.27e-6 A (Ni 0.20), 1.0e-5 A (Ni 0.16). Index 11 is the highest measured value.
